intro: Slimy Menace addresses a growing murloc infestation along the shores of Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest. These aggressive creatures threaten to deplete the lake's fish supply and endanger nearby locals, requiring swift action to keep their numbers in check.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match.
If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can hear their warbling from here--it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
